- $ \vec{AD} = (7, -2) $

$$
\cos(\theta) = \frac{\vec{AB} \cdot \vec{AD}}{|\vec{AB}||\vec{AD}|} = \frac{2 \cdot 7 + 4 \cdot (-2)}{\sqrt{2^2 + 4^2} \cdot \sqrt{7^2 + (-2)^2}} = \frac{14 - 8}{\sqrt{20} \cdot \sqrt{53}} = \frac{6}{\sqrt{1060}} \approx 0.1843
$$

$$

$$

$$
